title: Acceder al Panel y navegar a Resumen desde la navegación
description: Verifica que un usuario autenticado puede ver métricas en /panel y navegar a /panel/resumen para ver el resumen financiero y gráficos.

title: Validar contenido visible de métricas rápidas y tarjetas en el Panel
description: Verifica que el Panel principal muestra métricas rápidas y/o tarjetas de actividad reciente de forma visible tras iniciar sesión.

title: Cargar Resumen: se muestra estado de carga y luego datos exitosos
description: Verifica que /panel/resumen muestra un estado de carga y luego presenta gráficos y totales cuando los datos cargan correctamente.

title: Resumen muestra totales y tendencias una vez cargado
description: Verifica que en /panel/resumen son visibles el resumen financiero (totales) y al menos un indicador de tendencia una vez finaliza la carga.

title: Navegación cruzada: volver del Resumen al Panel principal
description: Verifica que el usuario puede volver desde /panel/resumen al Panel principal mediante navegación de la aplicación.

title: Robustez de UI: desplazamiento en Resumen mantiene visibles secciones clave
description: Verifica que al hacer scroll en /panel/resumen, siguen siendo accesibles/visibles secciones clave como totales y gráficos (sin quedar en blanco).

steps.description: Scroll to the bottom of the page

title: View client list, search, and open a client profile
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can view the client list, search, and open a client profile to see personal and physical data.

steps.description: Click on "Clientes" in the main navigation/menu
Type "a" into the client search field
Click on the first client row in the list

title: Create a new client with required fields and see it in the list
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can add a new client by completing required fields and then see the client in the client list.

steps.description: Click on "Clientes" in the main navigation/menu

title: Attempt to create a client with missing required fields and see validation errors
description: Verifies that the client creation form enforces required fields and shows field-level validation errors without leaving the form.

steps.description: Click on "Clientes" in the main navigation/menu
Verify text "Este campo es obligatorio" is visible

title: Edit an existing client's contact information and verify it updates on the profile
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can edit a client profile, save changes, and see updated contact info on the profile page.

steps.description: Click on "Clientes" in the main navigation/menu
Click on the first client row in the list

title: Search for a non-matching term shows no results (or empty state)
description: Verifies that searching for a term with no matching clients presents a clear empty state and does not open a profile.

steps.description: Click on "Clientes" in the main navigation/menu
Type "zzzz-no-existe-12345" into the client search field

title: Cancel/close new client form does not create a client and returns to list
description: Verifies that leaving the new client form via cancel/close returns to the list and does not add the partially entered client.

steps.description: Click on "Clientes" in the main navigation/menu
Type "Cliente Temporal" into the client search field

title: Validation clears after fixing missing required fields on the new client form
description: Verifies that validation errors appear for missing required fields and disappear after providing valid values.

steps.description: Click on "Clientes" in the main navigation/menu
Verify text "Este campo es obligatorio" is visible

title: Create a new membership plan successfully
description: Verifies an authenticated user can create a plan with valid name, price, and duration and see it listed.

steps.description: Click on "Planes" in the panel navigation
Type "Plan Mensual QA" into the plan name field
Verify text "Plan Mensual QA" is visible

title: Validate negative price when creating a plan
description: Verifies the create plan form blocks saving when price is negative and shows a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on "Planes" in the panel navigation
Type "Plan Negativo QA" into the plan name field
Verify text "Plan Negativo QA" is visible

title: Required field validation when creating a plan (missing name)
description: Verifies the create plan form blocks saving when a required field is empty and shows a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on "Planes" in the panel navigation
Type "" into the plan name field

title: Cancel out of create plan form without saving
description: Verifies a user can exit the create plan screen using a cancel/back action and no new plan appears in the list.

steps.description: Click on "Planes" in the panel navigation
Type "Plan No Guardar QA" into the plan name field
Verify text "Plan No Guardar QA" is not visible

title: Record a new payment (cash) and verify it appears in the list
description: Verifies a user can record a payment using Efectivo and see it added to the payments history.

steps.description: Click on "Pagos" in the panel navigation
Select "Efectivo" from the payment method dropdown

title: Record a new payment (card) and verify it appears in the list
description: Verifies a user can record a payment using Card and see it added to the payments history.

steps.description: Click on "Pagos" in the panel navigation
Select "Card" from the payment method dropdown

title: Record a new payment (transfer) and verify it appears in the list
description: Verifies a user can record a payment using Transfer and see it added to the payments history.

steps.description: Click on "Pagos" in the panel navigation
Select "Transfer" from the payment method dropdown

title: Filter payments by date range and verify list and totals update
description: Verifies the date range filters update the visible transactions and the totals shown on the payments page.

steps.description: Click on "Pagos" in the panel navigation
Click on the date range filter control
Select "Últimos 7 días" from the date range options

title: Amount is required when recording a payment (validation error)
description: Verifies the payment form blocks saving when the amount is empty and shows a visible validation error.

steps.description: Click on "Pagos" in the panel navigation
Select "Efectivo" from the payment method dropdown

title: Open an existing transaction and verify details are shown
description: Verifies a user can open a transaction and see client and subscription information in the details view.

steps.description: Click on "Pagos" in the panel navigation
Click on the first transaction in the payments list

title: Cancel recording a payment and return to payments list without changes
description: Verifies the user can exit the record payment flow via cancel/back and return to the payments list.

steps.description: Click on "Pagos" in the panel navigation

title: Payments page shows list and totals on initial load
description: Verifies the payments page loads successfully and shows a visible list area and totals section.

steps.description: Click on "Pagos" in the panel navigation

title: Generar plan de nutrición desde Evaluación Física (éxito)
description: Verifica que se pueda generar un plan con calorías, agua y macronutrientes desde la evaluación física de un cliente.

steps.description: Click on the first visible client row in the clients list/table

title: Plan de nutrición muestra calorías, agua y macros generados
description: Verifica que, tras completar los datos, el resultado incluya calorías diarias, objetivo de agua y distribución de macronutrientes visible.

steps.description: Click on the first visible client row in the clients list/table
Select "Moderado" from the Activity level/Nivel de actividad dropdown

title: Generar rutina de entrenamiento (éxito)
description: Verifica que se pueda generar una rutina seleccionando objetivo e intensidad y que se muestren bloques de rutina y ejercicios sugeridos.

steps.description: Click on the first visible client row in the clients list/table

title: Validación: falta un campo requerido en evaluación física
description: Verifica que al dejar un dato obligatorio vacío se muestre un error de validación y no se avance al resultado.

steps.description: Click on the first visible client row in the clients list/table
Select "Ligero" from the Activity level/Nivel de actividad dropdown

title: Validación: métricas no numéricas en peso/altura
description: Verifica que el formulario rechace valores no numéricos en campos métricos y muestre un mensaje de error visible.

steps.description: Click on the first visible client row in the clients list/table

title: Rutina: evitar generación sin seleccionar objetivo
description: Verifica que el generador de rutina exija seleccionar un objetivo antes de generar y muestre un error si falta.

steps.description: Click on the first visible client row in the clients list/table

title: Cambio de tema: alternar a modo oscuro desde el control de tema
description: Verifica que al activar el control de tema se cambia inmediatamente a modo oscuro con un indicador visible.

steps.description: Click on the theme control (Light/Dark) in the header

title: Cambio de tema: alternar a modo claro desde el control de tema
description: Verifica que al volver a modo claro el indicador visible del tema se actualiza correctamente.

steps.description: Click on the theme control (Light/Dark) in the header
